Discussions are expected to center on bolstering regional defense capabilities and addressing evolving geopolitical threats, particularly in the wake of Russia’s actions in Ukraine. The leaders will also explore collaborative efforts to diversify energy infrastructure and reduce reliance on Russian energy sources. A joint statement is anticipated following the conclusion of the summit tomorrow.

documents.title: European Regulators Approve Long-Acting HIV Prevention Treatment
documents.body: The European Medicines Agency (EMA) has granted approval for Cablivi, a novel long-acting injectable medication designed to prevent HIV infection. Clinical trials demonstrated high efficacy with a single injection administered every eight weeks. The treatment offers a discreet and potentially more convenient alternative to daily oral pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP). Rollout across European Union member states is anticipated to begin by mid-year, pending national adoption processes.

documents.body: A previously unknown collection of poems and prose by Polish Romantic poet, Julian Ursyn Niemcewicz, has been unearthed at the Austrian National Library in Vienna. The manuscript, believed to date from the 1820s, was miscatalogued and stored amongst a collection of diplomatic correspondence. Experts are hailing the discovery as a significant contribution to understanding Niemcewicz’s literary development and his perspective on the Napoleonic era. Initial analysis suggests the work contains previously unknown reflections on Polish nationalism and European politics.
